gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were 1,301.5 (USD millions). During 2017 management reassessed prior year claims provisions and recorded a net release of 90.9 (USD millions), equivalent to a c.7.0% reduction of opening gross claims reserves. The release was attributed to favourable claims development across multiple classes (notably Marine, Political Risk, Political Violence & War, Property and Specialty) while 2017 itself was impacted by significant natural catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) which drove increased current year large loss severity.
